title: Project Manager Civil
description:
Role & Responsibilities Project Manager (Civil Construction) Plan, execute and monitor construction projects from initiation to completion. Oversee day-to-day site operations and ensure work progresses as per approved drawings, specifications and timelines. Manage contractors, subcontractors, vendors, engineers and site supervisors. Ensure timely execution of civil, structural, finishing and interior works. Monitor project budgets, cost control, material procurement and resource allocation. Coordinate with architects, consultants, structural engineers and other stakeholders. Review BOQs, project estimates, drawings and technical specifications. Ensure quality control, safety standards and compliance with construction regulations. Track project progress, identify delays and implement corrective measures. Conduct regular site inspections and progress review meetings. Manage billing, contractor payments, work orders and measurement records. Ensure proper documentation, MIS reports and project updates to management. Handle snagging, rectification, finishing and final project handover. Ensure projects are completed within approved budgets and committed timelines. Preferred Candidate Profile Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering. Minimum 5–8 years of experience in civil construction and project management. Proven experience handling end-to-end construction projects, preferably hotels, resorts, commercial buildings or real estate developments. Strong knowledge of civil construction, structural works, finishing, MEP coordination and interior execution. Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Excel, MS Project and project planning tools. Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural and technical drawings. Strong knowledge of BOQ, estimation, budgeting, billing and cost control. Experience in contractor management, vendor coordination and site supervision. Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple activities, meet strict deadlines and ensure quality standards. Willingness to travel and manage on-site project execution as required. Key Requirement: The candidate should be hands-on, independently capable of managing construction sites and accountable for project delivery, quality, cost and timelines.
